method: Source and archived JSON review only. No browser, game, test or build was run for this report. Manifests describe read-time bytes; parallel v075 implementation may subsequently change source.

requirements.exactText: - `AC-M14-06`：常驻 HUD 使用克制的生物科技风格，玩家、病毒、器官危机和抗体效果层级清楚；在不同器官配色下均有足够文字/形状对比，面板不成为主要光污染源。
- `AC-M14-07`：正式战斗时使用高密度病毒、粒子、前景遮挡场景验证目标/危险/弱点可读；同时提供低特效档并保证危险判定提示不消失。
12. `RUN-12` 风格与战斗可读性：同场景病毒三分支形态对照→心脏搏动及肺部气流对照→密集混战/低特效→玩家、危险、弱点和当前器官均能辨认。
| `VIS-07` | G1–G2 | 危险、弱点、扫描与治疗至少两种非颜色信号；高光和粒子不过度盖住关键角色/预警 | 常规与密集战斗截图 |
| `VIS-10` | G4 | 实时 HUD 在 1366×768 与 1920×1080 下不遮挡关键可射击区域，缩放后布局/提示可读 | 多分辨率截图 |
| `VIS-11` | G4 | 普通/低特效模式下的伤害与碰撞判定一致，低特效仍显示所有致命警示；压力战斗满足 M16 帧率预算 | 同 seed 对比 + 帧率报告 |

findings.finding: Active source-to-tissue ring, dashed path, arrows and countdown are drawn before y-sorted bodies, raised obstacles, foreground and post-effects. The later passes can obscure essential crisis cues. Actor-only obstacle fading does not protect danger geometry.
findings.recommendation: Separate introductory ground hints from essential crisis cues and draw essential cues after foreground/effects. Preserve true source/tissue coordinates, IDs, chargeRemaining and blocked/paused/exhausted semantics.

findings.finding: Ordinary and mother-core dangers are late-rendered, but later labels and grouped weakness captions have no common protected-region pool. Existing target-only occupied bounds do not include danger captions, facilities, tissue, protocol or HUD rectangles.
findings.recommendation: Use shared scene label placement for danger captions and weakness; protect exact hazard boundaries/crosses without moving or merging attack geometry. Pure no-overlap assertions are necessary checks, not proof of human readability.

findings.finding: Full-state immutability harness is reusable, but has no bound runner, semantic primitive record, transform/clip/alpha inspection, pass-order proof, HUD measurement or viewport density qualification.
findings.recommendation: Attach an isolated runner and semantic recording adapter; retain actual native Canvas screenshots and human visual review.

archiveScan.note: References include repeated/nested snapshots and are not unique runs. Archive scan did not execute gameplay. Capture provenance/version remains v074.
missing: No active mother-core attack GameState found among these 375 references, despite route PNGs/events; cannot reconstruct a full snapshot from screenshots/events. Capture future crystal/fission/corrosion/brood snapshots through ordinary legal input.
Selected high-target states have 25 world targets; in-view density, simultaneous foreground overlap and HUD-to-threat overlap were not qualified by this scan.
Existing normal/low archived PNGs are different ticks and cannot be an exact-state A/B result.

pureDrawProtocol.input: One complete immutable archived real GameState + immutable aim + explicit output viewport. Do not modify its player, targets, clock, traits, attacks or effects to complete real-scene coverage.
pureDrawProtocol.isolation: Independent pure drawing page imports Renderer but not main.ts/GameSession/step; no route that injects a snapshot into a released live game.
pureDrawProtocol.equivalence: Clone original state into normal/low independently, create separate Renderer instances, use symmetric warmup for GrowthVisuals caches, await fonts.ready, and render 2–120 frames at identical tick/elapsed. Each frame compares complete JSON and SHA-256 plus existing HP/damage/collision subfingerprints for original/normal/low.
pureDrawProtocol.oracle: Derive expected sources, guard eligibility, coordinates/radii, wall-clipped vertices and countdown text from serialized state independently of draw callbacks. Record actual Canvas primitive method/arguments, transform, save/restore, clip, globalAlpha, line style and draw-pass order. Never stub a recorder to return expected signals.
assertions: Every eligible ordinary attack retains its aim/radius, dashed inner boundary, nonzero effective stroke alpha, progress arc and X in both modes.
Every pending split position remains even after mother death. No unrelated target supplies its landing cue.
Each core variant retains every serialized landing/aim and true range; sweep vertices follow actual world wall clipping; interrupt instruction follows true range/cooldown.

Crisis source/organization IDs and real chargeRemaining match source snapshot. Both modes retain source/tissue/path/arrow semantics and post-foreground/effects pass order. Paused/blocked/exhausted/wrong-organ/dead/short-path cases use their legitimate guards.

Shared measured scene-label bounds must be finite, viewport-clamped, respect known HUD rectangles and protected danger strokes/crosses, with explicit essential fallback diagnostics. No label is counted as a preserved primitive if effective alpha is zero or wholly clipped.
Match required semantic signals between modes; allow reduced decorative particles and minor stroke width differences. Do not demand entire PNG identity.

Real native Canvas output must still be inspected at final display size: player silhouette, each hazard extent/origin/direction/time, focused weakness and current organ remain visually distinguishable under foreground/effects and HUD. Record actual screenshot paths and reviewed findings.
pureDrawProtocol.syntheticBoundary: Explicitly named synthetic pure-draw composition fixtures may combine overlapping threats/foreground/HUD to exercise layout. Keep them separate from unmodified real-snapshot evidence; they do not prove reachability, official campaign success, human understanding or fun.
forbiddenShortcuts: Pixel count differences do not imply readable or unreadable.
No mutation/injection into live game to fabricate a missing dense scene.
No viewport/DPR trick or synthetic blur substitutes for native OS focus/minimize or real browser zoom.

harnessReuse.reuse: Independent real Canvas pair, full JSON/SHA equality, state subfingerprints and symmetric frame loop.
harnessReuse.adapter: Runner, provenance manifest, semantic primitive/layer recorder, HUD integration, selected real-source matrix, final screenshots review.

harnessReuse.reuse: True serialized angle/range/radius/landing and wall-clipped sweep tests.
harnessReuse.adapter: Track alpha/transforms/clip/pass order/styles/text and low parity; classify these current fixtures as synthetic mechanism tests.

harnessReuse.reuse: Low-mode crisis rings/timer, immutable state and absent/dead/off-organ guards.
harnessReuse.adapter: Post-effects separation and actual geometry/time/alpha assertions, blocked/paused/exhausted/short-path negatives, full compositor contract.

harnessReuse.reuse: Save/restore/clip recorder and genuine raised obstacle contours.
harnessReuse.adapter: Broaden recorder for transformed danger primitives and label bounds; actor occlusion alone cannot prove warning retention.

harnessReuse.reuse: Explicit synthetic pure-render illustration and cautious mask geometry description.
harnessReuse.adapter: Do not use modified clones as real snapshot A/B or human acceptance.

harnessReuse.reuse: Real-input capture route and capture guard patterns.
harnessReuse.adapter: Current sequential modes do not share a tick; snapshot replay must remain in the independent pure-draw page.

openAcceptance: VIS10 still requires actual DOM HUD rectangles, both 1366×768 and 1920×1080, and real zoom evidence. Canvas-only captures do not close it.
VIS11 damage/collision invariance needs actual existing mechanism tests plus final source/build regression; pure draw immutability does not execute damage.
New per-frame layout requires its own performance check; archived v074 600s FPS does not certify v075.
No 5-player blind-playtest, native OS focus/minimize or real zoom claim is made.
